subject: general
question: A can do (1)/(5) of the work in 3 days and B can do (1)/(4) of the work in 7.5 days . Working together, A and B can do (4)/(5) of the same work in:
solution:
**Given:**

Number of days taken by A to complete (1)/(5) of the work = 3 days

Number of days taken by B to complete (1)/(4) of the work = 7.5 days

**Concept Used:**

Rate of work = 1 / Time taken

**Calculation:**

Time taken by A to complete the work = (1)/(5)times(1)/(3) = (1)/(15)

Time taken by B to complete the work = (1)/(4)times(1)/(7.5) = (1)/(30)

Time taken to complete the whole work together = (1)/(15)+(1)/(30)=(1)/(10) = 10 days

According to the question,

Time taken to complete (4)/(5) of the work together = (4)/(5)×10=8 days.

**Hence, the time taken by A and B, to work together to complete (4)/(5)** **of the work is 8 days.**
